member.name: T:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.Migrator.MigrationContext
member.summary: Defines the available contextual scopes for database schema migrations.

remarks.para: Notice: The application exclusively supports PostgreSQL. All migrations target PostgreSQL dialect.

member.name: F:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.Migrator.MigrationContext.All
member.summary: Executes all migration scripts across every domain context (Common, Optimizations, Plugins).

member.name: F:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.Migrator.MigrationContext.Common
member.summary: Executes common baseline migrations only (e.g., stored_files).

member.name: F:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.Migrator.MigrationContext.Optimizations
member.summary: Executes experimental data, constitutive modeling, and parametric sweep migrations (includes Common as a prerequisite).

member.name: F:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.Migrator.MigrationContext.Plugins
member.summary: Executes dynamic plugin cache persistence migrations.

member.name: T:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.Migrator.MigratorEngine
member.summary: Executes contextual DDL database schema migrations against PostgreSQL using DbUp.

remarks.para: Notice: The application exclusively supports PostgreSQL. All migration scripts, connection builders, and journal tables are explicitly designed for and limited to PostgreSQL.

member.name: F:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.Migrator.MigratorEngine.SupportedDatabaseEngine
